final: WITH currency_averages AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(NULLIF(rebtotal, 0)) AS avg_rebate, AVG(CASE WHEN rebrate <> 0 AND feerate <> 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) AS avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS value FROM currency_averages) SELECT AVG(c.avg_rebate) AS avg_rebate, AVG(c.avg_gap) AS avg_relative_gap, AVG(c.avg_rebate - b.value) AS avg_excess_rebate FROM currency_averages AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL AND c.avg_rebate > b.value
